description: Standing query, zero violations expected: every successful decrypt of a customer key in the last three days was by a principal that key's declared model names. Models come from svc-sin-cfg-aws-keys-decrypt-only-declared, so configuration and observation are judged against one list. Covers events normalized since 2026-10-02 23:00 UTC, when the normalizer began keeping each call's key

params.query: SELECT r.uid AS key, actor.user.type AS actor_type, coalesce(actor.user.name, '') AS actor, count(*) AS events FROM normalized_events CROSS JOIN UNNEST(resources) AS t(r) WHERE source='aws' AND dt >= date_format(date_add('day', -2, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AND api.service.name = 'kms.amazonaws.com' AND api.operation = 'Decrypt' AND status = 'Success' AND r.type = 'AWS::KMS::Key' GROUP BY 1,2,3

matrix_rows.gap: AWS only: Cloud KMS audit logs are not in the corpus. Decrypts by AWS services are counted but not attributed, since the normalized event does not say which service acted.
